title.zh: SmartPay5 付款项目确认控制

purpose.en: Make the database the single fail-closed source for whether each current SmartPay5 payment preset is selectable.
purpose.zh: 让数据库成为每个当前 SmartPay5 付款预设是否可选的唯一默认关闭状态来源。

en: Administrators can Stop an enabled product without a wallet or contract transaction.
A stopped, missing, or stale product must be confirmed on-chain before it becomes selectable again.
zh: 管理员可在不调用钱包或合约的情况下 Stop 已启用项目。
已停止、无记录或指纹失效的项目必须经链上重新确认后才恢复可选。

en: SmartPay5 administrator product controls, checkout option discovery, payment preparation, D1 state, and deployment ordering.
zh: 影响 SmartPay5 管理员项目控制、付款选项读取、付款准备、D1 状态及部署顺序。

en: Store an exact fingerprint of mode, token addresses, mainID, secondID, atomic prices, and threshold.
Fail closed when no matching enabled record exists; any preset change invalidates the old confirmation.
Use one shared server checkout reader for both displayed options and payment preparation.
Remove the obsolete global pause-payment control without changing the SmartPay5 contract.
zh: 保存付款模式、代币地址、mainID、secondID、原子价格及门槛的精确指纹。
没有匹配的 enabled 记录时默认不可付款；预设任何变化都会使旧确认失效。
显示付款选项与付款准备共同复用同一个服务端结账读取器。
移除无用的全局暂停付款控件，不修改 SmartPay5 合约。

en: Run focused fail-closed, stale-fingerprint, database-only Stop, shared-reader, migration replay, repository tests, lint, and production build gates.
zh: 运行默认关闭、指纹失效、Stop 仅数据库、共享读取器、迁移重放、仓库测试、lint 与生产构建门禁。

en: No SmartPay5 Solidity, ABI, deployed address, token, payout wallet, price, product identity, site header/footer, or production record is changed; no real payment is submitted.
zh: 不修改 SmartPay5 Solidity、ABI、已部署地址、代币、收款钱包、价格、产品身份、站点页头/页脚或生产记录；不提交真实付款。

en: Preserve greatlovemeta.com branding, products, product-owner mapping, existing features, data, and independent infrastructure.
zh: 保留 greatlovemeta.com 品牌、产品、产品所有者映射、既有功能、数据及独立基础设施。

rollback.en: Roll back the runtime release and drop smartpay5_payment_item_states only if its product-control history is no longer required.
rollback.zh: 回滚运行版本；只有确认不再需要付款项目控制历史时才删除 smartpay5_payment_item_states。
